conversations_kind_matches_columns.name: conversations_kind_matches_columns
conversations_kind_matches_columns.value: ("conversations"."kind" = 'table' AND "conversations"."table_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."pair_key" IS NULL) OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'direct' AND "conversations"."pair_key" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."table_id" IS NULL)

game_tables_recurrence_matches_kind.name: game_tables_recurrence_matches_kind
game_tables_recurrence_matches_kind.value: ("game_tables"."kind" IN ('one_shot', 'adventure') AND "game_tables"."recurrence" IS NULL) OR ("game_tables"."kind" = 'campaign' AND "game_tables"."recurrence" IS NOT NULL)
